# Sandy writeup
## this is my writeup for the sandy malware challenge in huntress CTF 2025
 
Provided is the SANDY.zip file which extracts to a UPX packed PE  
  
After unpacking, I found out that it is a compiled autoit program, which is a scripting and automation tool for windows  

I then used the tool AutoIt-Ripper to extract it back to it's autoit .au3 form. 

Among other things, this contained a large blob of Base64 data called $base64chunks[]. After sanitising and decoding from base64 with cyberchef, this was another PowerShell script, this time containing a long list of encoded script, which were decoded and run. For example: 

```powershell

$encodedScript = ""
$decodedScript = [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String($encodedScript))
Invoke-Expression $decodedScript
```

Instead of manually decoding each one, I used a PowerShell trick I learned, simply replacing all of the Invoke-Expression statements with Write-Host so the decoded payloads would be written to the terminal which I put into a file:

```powershell

./decodedscript.ps1 > out.txt

```

After that, I searched for the text "flag{" in the file and got the flag.  

flag: flag{27768419fd176648b335aa92b8d2dab2}
